newsitem.title: ITALY: BankNapoli sells Il Mattino for 90 bln LIT.
newsitem.headline: BankNapoli sells Il Mattino for 90 bln LIT.

text.p: Loss-making Banco di Napoli on Friday signed a contract with Sidis Vision Spa to sell 100 percent of the capital of Il Mattino-Societa Editrice Meridionale - S.E.M. Spa, owner of the Naples daily Il Mattino, for 90 billion lire.
Investment bank IMI which handled the sale for Banco di Napoli announced the widely-expected move in a statement.

The Caltagirone group, through its Edime subsidiary, already runs the newspaper under a contract which was due to expire in 2001. Sidis, part of the Caltagirone group, operates in the information and local television sector.
The Caltagirone group already owns Rome dailies Il Tempo and Il Messaggero.
